item.description: Unlimited flags and environments self-hosted for free Open-source feature management giving unlimited flags, projects, and environments when you self-host. The pay-as-you-go cloud plan starts at $75 per seat per month with a 14-day trial.

item.title: Expo EAS — Free Tier (30 Builds/Month)
item.description: 30 free cloud builds a month — ship iOS without owning a Mac Managed build and submit service for React Native apps. The free tier includes 15 Android and 15 iOS builds per month on a low-priority queue with 60-minute build limits, so you never need a local Mac to ship.

item.title: Scalar — Free Open Source + Free Plan
item.description: Beautiful API references from an OpenAPI spec, free to self-host Modern OpenAPI reference rendering with a free hosted plan and an open-source generator you can self-host. Turns an existing OpenAPI description into polished, searchable API docs.

item.title: ConfigCat — Forever Free Plan
item.description: Forever-free feature flags with targeting rules and no seat pricing Feature flags and configuration management with a forever-free plan, targeting rules, and SDKs for every major language and platform.

item.title: ReadMe — Free Plan
item.description: A real API docs hub with interactive requests on a free plan Hosted developer hubs with an interactive API reference, guides, and live request examples generated from an OpenAPI file. A free plan covers a single project.

item.title: GitBook — Free Plan
item.description: Docs-as-code with Git sync on a free plan Documentation platform with a free plan, Git sync, and customizable sites. Paid tiers lift visitor limits and add custom domains.

item.title: Redocly — Free Plan + Free CLI
item.description: Free OpenAPI linting and doc builds in CI API documentation toolchain: hosted reference docs plus a free CLI that lints, bundles, and validates OpenAPI descriptions in CI.

item.title: Statsig — Free Tier
item.description: Experimentation platform with a free tier for early projects Feature gates, experiments, and product analytics with a free tier for early projects and usage-based pricing as events grow.

item.title: Codemagic — 500 Free macOS M2 Minutes/Month
item.description: 500 free macOS M2 build minutes — Flutter CI without a Mac CI/CD built for Flutter and mobile. The free tier includes 500 macOS M2 minutes per month, unlimited applications, and one parallel build — enough to build and ship a side project without owning Apple hardware.

item.title: Bitrise — Free Tier
item.description: Mobile-focused CI with a free tier for side projects Mobile CI/CD with a free tier that covers builds and deploy steps for iOS and Android projects, plus a large library of prebuilt steps.

item.title: Langfuse — Free Tier (50k Observations/Month)
item.description: 50k observations a month free and self-hostable — the default choice for LLM tracing Open-source LLM observability and evaluation: hierarchical traces capture every LLM call, tool invocation, and retrieval step. The cloud free tier covers 50,000 observations per month and it is fully self-hostable.

item.title: Helicone — Free Tier
item.description: Drop-in LLM logging and caching that answers what you spend per user A one-line-integration proxy for LLM calls that logs requests, tracks cost and latency per user, and adds caching, rate limiting, and fallbacks. Free at low volume and self-hostable.

item.title: LangSmith — Free Developer Tier
item.description: The default tracing layer if you already build on LangChain LangChain's tracing, evaluation, and prompt-engineering tooling for LLM applications, with a free tier intended for development and small-scale production.

item.title: Arize Phoenix — Free & Open Source, No Card
item.description: Local-first LLM tracing you can run yourself, free and no card Open-source LLM tracing and evaluation you can run locally with a single command or use on the free Arize AX cloud. No credit card required to start tracing in a notebook.

item.title: Portkey — Free Tier
item.description: One gateway for many models with fallbacks and guardrails, free to start An LLM gateway and observability layer putting 1,600+ models behind one API, with routing, fallbacks, guardrails, and cost tracking. A free tier covers development use.

item.title: Braintrust — Free Developer Tier
item.description: Serious eval tooling for comparing models and prompts Evaluation and observability for AI products: datasets, scorers, experiment tracking, and side-by-side model comparisons so changes are measured rather than guessed. Free developer tier available.

item.title: W&B Weave — Free Personal Tier
item.description: LLM evaluations wired into the experiment tracker you already use Weights & Biases' framework for evaluating and tracing LLM applications, with a free personal tier and tight integration with W&B experiments and datasets you may already use.

item.title: Plunk — 1,000 Emails/Month + Unlimited Contacts
item.description: Unlimited contacts on the free plan and $0.001 per email after that Open-source email platform for transactional and marketing sends. The free plan includes 1,000 emails a month with unlimited contacts, then $0.001 per email — you are never charged per stored contact.

item.title: Mailgun — 100 Emails/Day Free
item.description: Free transactional sending on an API-first platform Transactional email API with a free tier of up to 100 emails per day, plus address validation, inbound routing, and detailed delivery analytics.

item.title: Brevo — Free Plan, No Credit Card
item.description: Email, SMS, and CRM on one free plan with no card required Email and SMS marketing plus CRM and automation in one platform. Signup requires no credit card and the free plan includes a daily sending allowance with contact storage.

item.title: Loops — Free Tier
item.description: Modern transactional email API with a free tier for SaaS Email built for SaaS products, putting transactional and marketing sends behind one modern API with a visual editor and a free tier for early projects.

item.title: Buttondown — Free Newsletter Tier
item.description: The fastest way to start a developer newsletter with a free tier Newsletter platform with a free tier, built-in subscribe pages, and plain-text-first sending. Paid tiers add subscribers, automation, and paid subscriptions.

item.title: Mailjet — Free Tier
item.description: A free monthly email allowance on EU-hosted infrastructure Transactional and marketing email with a free monthly sending allowance, EU-based infrastructure, and a visual template builder.

item.title: RevenueCat — Free Until $2,500 Monthly Revenue
item.description: Full subscription infrastructure free until you are already earning In-app purchase and subscription infrastructure for mobile apps. The full feature set — entitlements, paywall experiments, analytics, and webhooks — is free until you reach $2,500 in monthly tracked revenue.

item.title: Lemon Squeezy — Free Test Drive, No Card
item.description: Digital-product payments with tax handled and no card to start Merchant of record for digital products with checkout links, licence keys, subscriptions, and global tax handled for you. Sign up and take a test drive free with no card, then pay per transaction rather than a monthly fee.

item.title: Adapty — Free Until $5K/Month Revenue
item.description: Paywall A/B testing free while you are still under $5K/month Mobile paywall and subscription management with paywall A/B testing, analytics, and no-code builder. Free until you earn $5K per month in tracked revenue.

item.title: Paddle — Merchant of Record, No Monthly Fee
item.description: Global tax and VAT handled for you with no monthly platform fee Merchant of record for software and SaaS. Paddle handles global tax, invoicing, and compliance as the seller of record and charges per transaction instead of a monthly platform fee.

item.title: Polar — Usage Metering on Per-Transaction Pricing
item.description: Usage metering down to tokens and GPU seconds, priced per transaction Merchant of record built for developers: usage metering down to tokens or GPU seconds, free or paid trials that convert automatically, licence keys, benefits, and GitHub-native workflows.

item.title: Creem — Merchant of Record With Free Allowances
item.description: Usage-based billing with free allowances and built-in affiliate payouts Merchant of record with usage-based pricing, credit wallets, free allowances, affiliate commission tracking, and per-unit pricing attached to any product.

item.title: Semgrep — Free Tier + Free Open Source
item.description: SAST in CI with a free tier and an open-source rule engine Static application security testing that runs in CI and the editor, with a free tier and an open-source rule engine so you can write your own patterns.

item.title: Socket — Free Tier
item.description: Catches malicious packages that vulnerability scanners miss, free for OSS Supply-chain security for dependencies that flags malicious and risky package behaviour at install time and in pull requests, catching what vulnerability databases do not. A free tier covers open-source projects.

item.title: GitGuardian — Free Tier (Individual)
item.description: Secret scanning with history coverage, free for individual developers Detects leaked secrets across repositories and full git history, with a free tier for individual developers and remediation plus honeytoken features on paid plans.

item.title: Aikido Security — Free Tier
item.description: Five scanners in one dashboard with a free tier All-in-one application security: SAST, dependency, container, infrastructure-as-code, and secret scanning surfaced in a single dashboard with a free tier for small teams.

item.title: Mend.io — Free Developer Tier
item.description: Dependency and licence risk scanning with a free developer tier Software composition analysis and dependency risk management for open-source components, including licence compliance, with a free developer tier.

item.title: Swetrix — Free Plan (100,000 Events/Month)
item.description: 100k events a month free and open source, self-host when you outgrow it Open-source, cookie-less web analytics with a free plan covering 100,000 events per month, plus error tracking and performance monitoring. Self-host if you outgrow it.

item.title: Fathom Analytics — 7-Day Trial, Then From $15/mo
item.description: Cookie-free analytics from $15/mo with no consent banner Privacy-first, cookie-free analytics with a 7-day free trial and plans from $15/month. No cookie banner needed because nothing personal is collected.

item.title: OpenPanel — Free Self-Hosted + EU Cloud From $2.50/mo
item.description: Self-host product analytics free, or EU cloud from $2.50/mo Open-source product analytics you can self-host for free, with a GDPR-compliant EU cloud option starting at $2.50 per month.

item.title: Simple Analytics — 30-Day Free Proof of Concept
item.description: Run it next to GA4 free for 30 days before switching Privacy-friendly analytics with a free 30-day proof of concept so you can run it alongside GA4 on real traffic before committing.

item.title: Matomo Cloud — 21-Day Trial + Free Self-Hosted
item.description: Self-host free forever, or try the cloud for 21 days with no card The leading open-source analytics platform. Take a 21-day cloud trial with no credit card, or self-host it free forever with full data ownership.

item.title: Mercury Perks — $0/Month Banking + Startup Bundle
item.description: Free business banking plus an aggregated perk bundle you can claim after incorporating Mercury offers $0/month business banking and publishes a Startup Bundle of partner perks for newly formed companies, covering cloud credits, SaaS discounts, and finance tooling.

item.title: Notion for Startups — Up to 6 Months Free (Business + AI)
item.description: Six months of the paid Notion Business plan with AI included Eligible startups get up to six months of the Notion Business plan free, with Notion AI included, plus partner credits through the program.

item.title: Brex Startup Perks — Partner Perks Bundle
item.description: A directory of startup credits and discounts, free to claim Brex publishes a partner-perk directory for startups — credits and discounts across cloud, AI, and SaaS vendors — alongside its corporate card and banking products.

item.title: Deel Perks — Partner Perks Bundle
item.description: Global hiring and infrastructure perks bundled with a payroll platform Deel's perks program collects credits and discounts from payroll, HR, and infrastructure vendors for companies hiring globally.

item.title: n8n — Free Self-Hosted (Community Edition)
item.description: Unlimited workflow executions free when self-hosted, where Zapier charges per task Workflow automation with 400+ integrations, self-hostable under a fair-code licence with unlimited executions when you run the community edition yourself.

item.title: Metabase — Free Self-Hosted (Open Source)
item.description: Unlimited BI seats free self-hosted instead of per-user dashboard pricing Open-source business intelligence and dashboards. The self-hosted open-source edition is free with unlimited users and can be running from a container in minutes.

item.title: Appsmith — Free Self-Hosted (Unlimited Users)
item.description: Unlimited internal-tool seats when you self-host instead of paying per user Open-source internal-tool builder. Self-host it free with unlimited users and connect databases, REST APIs, and GraphQL sources to build admin panels and dashboards.

item.title: Dokploy — Free Self-Hosted PaaS
item.description: Heroku-style deploys on your own VPS with no seat pricing Open-source self-hosted alternative to Heroku and Vercel: deploy containerized applications and databases across your own servers, with a 7-day cloud trial if you would rather not self-host. No card required for the trial.

item.title: Airbyte — Free Open-Source Connectors
item.description: Run ELT pipelines yourself instead of paying per connector and per row Open-source data integration with hundreds of connectors. The self-managed engine is free to run yourself, with a managed cloud option for teams that would rather not operate it.

item.title: Budibase — Free Self-Hosted (Unlimited Users)
item.description: Unlimited users and apps free when self-hosted Low-code platform for internal tools and workflows with a free self-hosted edition covering unlimited users and apps, plus generated forms, CRUD screens, and approval flows.

item.title: ToolJet — Free Self-Hosted
item.description: 40+ data-source integrations with no per-user licence Open-source low-code platform for internal tools with 40+ data-source integrations and a visual builder. Self-hosting is free with no per-user licence.

item.title: Windmill — Free Self-Hosted (Open Source)
item.description: Script-to-workflow automation with no per-run pricing when self-hosted Turn scripts into workflows, internal apps, and scheduled jobs. The open-source edition is free to self-host with unlimited workers, and it handles retries and approval steps.

item.title: CapRover — Free Self-Hosted PaaS
item.description: One-click app deploys on a cheap VPS with no platform fee A self-hosted PaaS that turns any VPS into a one-click deployment platform with a web dashboard, automatic SSL, and a large one-click app store.

item.title: EuroHPC AI Factories — Free Supercomputer GPU Access for EU Startups
item.description: The largest publicly funded GPU access open to a European startup, and it runs on supercomputers rather than a cloud console Free, customised support and compute access for European startups and SMEs through the EU network of 19 AI Factories and 13 Antennas. Each AI Factory operates its own access route to the supercomputer it is attached to, and the capacity is aimed at AI model work rather than general hosting. Publicly funded, so there is no invoice to manage.

item.title: Google TPU Research Cloud — 1,000+ Free Cloud TPUs
item.description: No dollar cap and no funding test — the largest research compute grant on the open web, and the results have to be published anyway Free access to a cluster of more than 1,000 Cloud TPU devices for machine learning research, at no charge, with support for TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX and Julia. There is no dollar cap. In exchange, participants are expected to share what they find — peer-reviewed publications, open source code, or blog posts — and to give Google feedback on the platform.

item.title: AMD AI Developer Program — Free Membership + Complimentary Compute Credits
item.description: The only route to free AMD Instinct GPU credits anywhere, and joining takes minutes with no hardware and no card Free membership for developers, students and startups, with complimentary compute credits from AMD Developer Cloud or Fireworks AI, or instant API access through Token Lab. Joining also includes a one-month complimentary DeepLearning.AI membership, a ten-level points scheme as you complete developer activities, and ROCm certification paths. No AMD hardware required.

item.title: RunPod Startup Program — $1,000-$25,000 GPU Credits
item.description: The largest no-investor GPU credit with a self-serve application — and it decides fast Tiered GPU credits decided by how much the company has raised and whether it is VC-backed: Starter for teams under $1M raised gets $1,000, Venture for teams with a verified VC on the cap table gets $5,000, and Growth for teams past $5M raised gets $10,000 to $25,000 against a usage commitment. Credits expire one year after issue, one free offer per company, and existing RunPod customers are not eligible for the free Starter or Venture credits.

item.title: Nebius for Startups — Credits, Reserved Capacity and Engineering Support
item.description: Reserved cluster capacity rather than a balance — the scarce thing when you are mid-training run and the region is sold out Startup credits and reserved cluster capacity for venture-backed AI-native startups, plus engineering support. Nebius also runs an AI Builder Program open to anyone with no funding requirement, and a Tavily partner track offering 100k free credits to companies backed by a VC or a top accelerator. Credit amounts are not published, so size is a conversation.

item.title: Guepard for Startups — Up to $30,000 Postgres Branching Credits
item.description: The biggest database credit gated on team size and stage rather than on a funding round size — a 19-person Series A qualifies Up to $30,000 in Guepard platform credits for Postgres environment branching, with twelve months to use them from activation, plus onboarding support. Built for venture-backed teams at Series A or earlier — typically under 20 employees and less than three years old. Review is rolling.

item.title: PlanetScale for Startups — Startup Pricing That Cuts the Bill, Not a Balance
item.description: The saving shows up on the invoice instead of a balance that expires — and there is nothing to spend down before the clock runs out A startup program that works by cutting the invoice rather than handing over an expiring credit balance, and no credit amount is published. Single-node Postgres databases start at $5/mo and high-availability Postgres clusters at $15/mo, and PlanetScale publishes a customer case where a production workload dropped from $900/mo to $90/mo.

item.title: Turbopuffer for Startups — $8,192 Vector DB Credits
item.description: The only vector database that publishes a fixed credit amount instead of a vague discount — you know the number before you apply $8,192 in vector database credits for startups under 50 employees and under $50M raised, or $2,048 plus a dedicated Slack channel for scaleups past either line. One set of credits per company, applied for through a single partner, valid for twelve months, and existing customers qualify for the full amount.

item.title: Read the Docs Community — Free Documentation Hosting for Open Source
item.description: The default documentation host for open source, and it stays free for exactly the projects that need it Always-free documentation hosting for open source and community projects, funded by advertising on the hosted pages. Paid Business plans start at $50/mo, Advanced at $150, Pro at $250, and Enterprise from $10,000/yr once a project outgrows the community tier — so the upgrade path is published rather than discovered at renewal.

item.title: SignPath Foundation — Free Code Signing for Open Source
item.description: Code signing normally costs $200-$500 a year, and almost no project knows the open source route exists Free code-signing certificates and signing service for qualifying open source projects. SignPath verifies that a binary was built from your repository and vouches for it under their own name, which removes the "unknown publisher" warning from Windows builds. Projects are required to display attribution on their site.
